purpose: Teach: 育毛/素顔/投球/真珠/灯油/ゾウ/主食/鯛

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが育毛のことで気にしてらっしゃるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been worried about his hair thinning lately.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact tone. A small smile underneath — knowing this is sensitive for him. Warm, not pitying. Steady breath, natural pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お母さんの素顔大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I love how Mom looks without makeup!
lines.style: Bright, immediate, eager to share something good. Genuine smile in the voice — no performance, just honest observation. Simple, direct rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと投球の練習しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't we go practice pitching with your dad?
lines.style: Warm invitation, not a command. Slight lift on the suggestion — offering something she knows he'll enjoy. Encouraging, gentle hand extended.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖母ちゃんが真珠のネックレスをくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandma gave me a pearl necklace!
lines.style: Excited, proud. Quick tempo, eager to share good news. Small laugh of pleasure underneath. The delight of someone who received something special.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが灯油を補給に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather went out to refill the kerosene just now.
lines.style: Casual observation, matter-of-fact. No tension — just informing him of a small household fact. Even, unremarkable tone, like mentioning the weather.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、動物園でゾウさん見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw an elephant at the zoo!
lines.style: Bright wonder, eager to share. Eyes-wide quality to the voice — the magic of having seen something big and real. Quick, bouncing tempo.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お米が日本のお主食なのよ
lines.en: Sho, rice is Japan's staple food, you know.
lines.style: Gentle teaching tone — not lecturing, just sharing something she thinks is worth knowing. Warm, patient. Like she's inviting him into a piece of culture.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんがお正月に鯛を出してくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa served sea bream at New Year's!
lines.style: Delighted, close and confiding. Warm memory in the voice — like he's sharing something special that happened. Soft, genuine, savoring the detail.
